nodes.label: Live Verification Against External Services
nodes.rationale: Unit-level assertions alone cannot prove the Option::pure fix behaves correctly at its real point of use, since the false sentinel that motivated the old bug is produced by the PHP runtime on a real network failure, not a test-controlled value; the fixed app was run as an actual HTTP server and driven with real requests against Open-Meteo and Frankfurter/ECB to close that gap.

nodes.label: Audit of All Call Sites Depending on Option::pure
nodes.norm_label: audit of all call sites depending on option::pure
nodes.rationale: Fixing one known call site is evidence only for that call site; changing the semantics of a foundational primitive like Option::pure is project-wide, so every construction/consumption site of Option was grepped and classified to confirm no other caller silently depended on the old false-as-absence behavior.

nodes.label: Property-Based Testing Layer (Future Work)
nodes.rationale: The law suite only tests fixed, hand-picked values; generating random floats, booleans, and graph shapes and checking each law automatically over hundreds of cases per run would very likely have caught Option::pure(false) and the sub-cent monoid rounding without waiting for a human reviewer to supply the exact counter-example.

nodes.label: Static Analysis Baseline for Kleisli-Arrow Shape (Future Work)
nodes.norm_label: static analysis baseline for kleisli-arrow shape (future work)
nodes.rationale: The remaining ad hoc InvalidArgumentException checks inside Some::bind and Right::bind are runtime guards against a mistake the type system could catch instead; PHP's lack of higher-kinded types makes a fully static alternative awkward, but Psalm/PHPStan with a custom plugin recognising the Kleisli-arrow shape could flag a non-conforming callback at the call site rather than at execution.

nodes.label: Category Theory Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uniquely applies Category Theory principles to ensure data integrity and provide clear error handling through a categorical pipeline.

nodes.label: Free Category Inductor F(G)
nodes.rationale: Ensures an itinerary is a connected, valid walk through the travel graph (Vertices Ob(F(G)) as travel states, Morphisms Hom(u,v) as composable paths of directed travel edges).

nodes.label: Functors
nodes.rationale: Used for applying discounts to all providers simultaneously.

nodes.label: Monads (Option/Either)
nodes.rationale: Used in the Kleisli pipeline for step-by-step itinerary building and short-circuiting invalid graph edges.

nodes.label: Monoids
nodes.rationale: Used to aggregate activity costs and evaluate the strict monoidal functor over the induced graph path.

nodes.label: Natural Transformations
nodes.rationale: Used to select the cheapest flight/hotel from available choices.

nodes.label: TripMetrics
nodes.rationale: Combines costs, durations, and points associatively.
